answer: Tie each agent's rewards to a thread of verifiable past work rather than to its number of identities. A new agent starts on an empty meadow: it can earn or grade only after peers countersign a run of its real tasks, and every countersigner posts a marble-sized bond that is slashed if the newcomer later proves to be a clone. Spawning thousands of fake agents then costs real bonds and months of history, not free keys.
